targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date AS first_day,
    ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date AS last_day
), ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT (time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date AS activity_day,
    platform, platform_account_id, user_id
  FROM bot_events_commands
  WHERE time >= ((($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date - 0)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
    AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND platform IN ('telegram','vk') AND NOT (module = 'Main' AND COALESCE(is_payload, false))
), normalized AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.activity_day, e.platform,
    COALESCE(pa.external_id, e.user_id::text) AS external_account_id
  FROM ids e
  LEFT JOIN platform_accounts pa ON pa.id = e.platform_account_id
), expanded AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day, n.platform, n.external_account_id
  FROM normalized n CROSS JOIN bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    GREATEST(n.activity_day, b.first_day)::timestamp,
    LEAST(n.activity_day + 0, b.last_day)::timestamp,
    interval '1 day'
  ) d(day)
  WHERE n.external_account_id IS NOT NULL
), totals AS (
  SELECT day, count(DISTINCT (platform, external_account_id)) AS active_users
  FROM expanded GROUP BY day
), days AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    b.first_day::timestamp, b.last_day::timestamp, interval '1 day'
  ) d(day)
)
SELECT days.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS time,
  COALESCE(totals.active_users, 0) AS active_users
FROM days LEFT JOIN totals USING (day) ORDER BY time

WITH periods AS (SELECT generate_series(time_bucket('$__interval', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    time_bucket('$__interval', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), '$__interval'::interval) AS time), counts AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('$__interval',time) AS time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE experimental) AS viewer,count(*) AS total
  FROM bot_events_render WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND platform IN ('telegram','vk') AND event_type='render_start' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.time,COALESCE(100.0*c.viewer/NULLIF(c.total,0),0) AS experimental_renders_percent
FROM periods p LEFT JOIN counts c USING (time) ORDER BY p.time

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '$__interval', 0),count(*) FILTER (WHERE experimental) AS experimental,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT experimental) AS ordr FROM bot_events_render WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND platform IN ('telegram','vk') AND event_type='render_start' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

  SELECT time_bucket('$__interval',time) AS time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE experimental AND event_type='render_success') AS viewer_success,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE experimental) AS viewer_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT experimental AND event_type='render_success') AS ordr_success,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT experimental) AS ordr_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='render_success') AS successes,count(*) AS total
  FROM bot_events_render WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND platform IN ('telegram','vk') AND event_type IN ('render_success','render_failed') GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.time,COALESCE(100.0*c.viewer_success/NULLIF(c.viewer_total,0),100) AS experimental,
  COALESCE(100.0*c.ordr_success/NULLIF(c.ordr_total,0),100) AS ordr,
  COALESCE(100.0*c.successes/NULLIF(c.total,0),100) AS total
FROM periods p LEFT JOIN counts c USING (time) ORDER BY p.time
